|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Azure Angel (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V2-L-azureangel-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-azureangel022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual2-Light/large/azureangel.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual2-Light/large/azureangel.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “LIN-V8K (Elleyein-Veeatekay)”. Text: “May add one pilot and one astromech. During battle, if Anakin or R2-D2 aboard, may lose 1 Force to cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] interrupt. While Anakin or R2-D2 aboard, immune to attrition < 5 (< 6 if both).”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Azure Angel (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 26 October 2022<ref name="img-azureangelab7dedd">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual2-Light/large/azureangel.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7deddc7ba5815bab0aff7ba0699002f6647d34 commit ab7dedd] (26 October 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual2-Light/large/azureangel.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' “May add one pilot and” → “May add 1 pilot and”; “pilot and one astromech. During” → “pilot and 1 astromech. During”; “to Sense] interrupt. While Anakin” → “to Sense] Interrupt. While Anakin”; the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (348×489 → 745×1039 pixels). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “LIN-V8K (Elleyein-Veeatekay)”. It is the current image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “May add 1 pilot and 1 astromech. During battle, if Anakin or R2-D2 aboard, may lose 1 Force to cancel a non-[Immune to Sense] Interrupt. While Anakin or R2-D2 aboard, immune to attrition < 5 (< 6 if both).”
